title: Love Beyond Memory
description: To escape her stepfather’s clutches, Iris Moon returned to the city where she grew up after graduating college. There, she founded a housekeeping firm, but because of poor management, she could not afford rent.One day, a man came to her, offering her a fortune to work as a live-in nanny for him. It was only upon getting into the car that she realized her future boss was none other than Cedric Klein, the man known all over the city for being abusive.

title: Genius Girlfriend
description: After Jiang Yubai grew up, Lin Zhixia suddenly confessed, "Jiang Yubai, I like you, in both the philosophical and biological sense." That night, his cheeks flushed, and he could hear his heart racing.

Now the company is in chaos, and the people who once ignored him are desperate to find him.

title: [Doublé]Supermarché de l’Apocalypse
description: Dans L'Ère de l'Apocalypse, les gens fuient devant Vigneau. Ils trouvent un supermarché et collaborent avec M. Mercier. Les ressources provoquent des conflits entre bases. M. Mercier montre ses compétences de gestion et apprivoise les êtres étranges. Une vente aux enchères révèle la vérité, des règles sont établies et un empire commercial se forme. Après les batailles du supermarché, le système se met à jour, vend des mets préhistoriques et escorte les clients aux bases.

title: After I Went Blind, I Slept With My Husband's Uncle
description: Ballerina Daisy loses her sight. When her vision returns, she discovers the man in her bed is her husband's uncle, Thorne. Her husband swapped her to carry on an affair. Daisy feigns blindness, plots revenge, and finds love with Thorne.

title: My Calorie Boy
description: Kang Jiawei and Xu Jingjing, along with their group of high school friends, navigate friendship, growth, and self-discovery, experiencing the highs and lows of their unique youth.

title: Invincible Bodyguard
description: A highly trained fighter goes undercover as a security guard to protect a brilliant scientist who invented "Aura" — a drug that could cure cancer. A ruthless powerful man wants her discovery at any cost. But as the mission unfolds, the fighter discovers a terrifying truth - his enemy's father destroyed his family years ago. This is no longer just a mission. It's personal.

title: In Love, In Silence
description:
"Queenie James lost her parents at a young age and was left to suffer under the cruel hands of her uncle and aunt. She managed to get into university—only to face new hardships due to her poverty and inability to speak.A chance encounter brought Harrison Fletcher, a cold and powerful CEO, into her life. Moved by her resilience, he stepped into her world and offered her a way out.
In Harrison's world, Queenie found something she had never dared to hope for: care, respect, and a family that accepted her for who she was. As their bond deepened, she learned that even those without a voice could be heard—when someone truly listened."

description: Adrian cancels his wedding for Celeste a third time, certain his “orphan” fiancée will never leave. Back in her father’s empire, she agrees to meet Dante Moretti, the ruthless mafia don who offers the respect Adrian never did. As Adrian uncovers Celeste’s betrayal and tears the world apart searching for Valentina, he discovers too late that the woman he took for granted may soon belong to his most dangerous rival.

title: The Legendary Mage Returns
description: Three years ago, transcendent S-rank legend Aiden fell, cursed and amnesiac by the Devouring Abyss. Radiant Academy prodigy Irene risked her life with Soul Link to wake his memories and power. Wielding a simple training staff, he beats rivals from five academies and exposes traitor Lance. He and Irene unleash Ice-Thunder Twin Soul Resonance to slay the Abyss Nine-Headed Demon God and Maeve. At last, he crowns Irene with the S-rank Guardian Sacred Crown.
